ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There are four soil structure pie charts in the figure, labeled ①②③④ respectively. ① shows minerals about 42%, organic matter 18%, water 26%, and air 14%; ② shows minerals 40%, organic matter 10%, water 45%, and air 5%; ③ shows minerals 54%, organic matter 6%, water 5%, and air 35%; ④ shows air 50%, water 4%, and additionally solid components of about 42% and 4% are labeled. Then reason: The soil of the Loess Plateau is mainly loess mineral particles, with relatively high mineral content; the local area is relatively dry, soil water content is low, and the proportion of air in pores is relatively high; organic matter content is not high. Among the four figures, ③ best fits the characteristics of “highest minerals, low water content, not high organic matter, and relatively much air,” so the one representing the soil of the Loess Plateau is the 3rd figure.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中四个土壤结构饼图分别标为①②③④，③显示矿物质54%、有机质6%、水5%、空气35%。再结合题干所说四地包括黄土高原等，利用黄土高原土壤以黄土矿物颗粒为主、较干燥且孔隙中空气较多的特征，在四图中寻找“矿物质最高、含水量低、有机质不高”的图。符合该特征的是③，因此答案为第3个图。
